describe: The image shows the panels of a metal rifle ammunition clip as a few large pieces in one sheet. The top strip is a dark slot holding one brass cartridge with a pointed tip. Below it is a wide blue-grey steel panel with light scratches and faint rust, and a lower panel with vertical raised ribs and grooves. Colours are cool steel grey and blue-grey with brass accents. Lighting is flat and even, with medium contrast. Each panel must stay exactly in place.
